title: Sidonius Apollinaris, Epistulae (Letters, 9 books) / RU: Сидоний Аполлинарий, «Письма» (RU-gap)
author: C. Sollius Modestus Apollinaris Sidonius (c. 430–c. 485), bishop of Clermont
size: 147 letters in 9 books; est. 65–70k words (plus 24 poems)
edition: Luetjohann, MGH AA 8 (1887), public domain: https://archive.org/details/gaisoliiapollin00ltgoog. Loyen, Budé
ru_evidence: Excerpts only: Trukhina, История Древнего Рима. Тексты и документы (2004), pp. 393–400; poems in Поздняя латинская поэзия (1982) and a 1998 anthology (per ru.wikipedia).
en_evidence: Anderson, Loeb (2 vols, 1936/1965); Dalton 1915, online (per en.wikipedia).
other_translations: French complete (Loyen, Budé). Many recent English and Italian commentaries on individual books.
value: Indispensable for the end of Roman Gaul: the Visigoths (portrait of Theoderic II), Euric, the siege of Clermont, the Gallo-Roman aristocracy. A first-rank gap in Russian.
ai_feasibility: low–medium: deliberately precious, allusive style. The English and French versions may be used for checking only, never as a base.
pilot_unit: Book 1 (11 letters, incl. 1.2 on Theoderic II; est. 7–8k words)
